description: ONE advisory move from engine-verified state: done | combine (exact roster; only if you are its elected broker — lowest agent_id in the roster — or the broker's grace has run out) | defer (another member is the broker: do not race, hold your listing and poll) | list (you hold a share the board is missing, or refresh=true: your own listing is about to expire, or join=true: you are unlisted with no share and the board already has the solvers it needs or is combinable — list so you are carried into the next round and elected there) | solve (a share that would raise the viable coalition, least-claimed then cheapest, spread across arrivals; a listed share-less agent is assigned by solver election, by rank) | wait (nothing you solve helps; a new holder must arrive — or enough other listings are already elected to solve: poll, and solve yourself only if no solve or claim lands for grace_s). Same policy as the reference client.
name: bounty_next_move
